description: Seinvoorbijrijding per type trein op hoofdsporen is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Een seinvoorbijrijding is het voorbijrijden van een signaal met een gesloten uiterlijk. Deze dataset bevat het aantal SPAD (« Signal Passed At Danger ») per type trein op de hoofdsporen. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Veiligheid. Its keywords are Seinvoorbijrijding. The portal shows 2022-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
